name: Machina Gearframe (Retro Formats)
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can add 1 "Machina" monster, except "Machina Gearframe", from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can equip this card to a Machine-Type monster you control as an Equip Card, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)

cdb_provenance.detail: type, atk, def, level, race, attribute and setcode are copied from the row for the modern card (42940404) in cards.cdb at the ignis-babelcdb revision pinned in data/sources.json. They are NOT independently checked against a period printing: a stat change between the period card and the modern one would not be reproduced. category (a client search filter, not gameplay) is left 0 rather than copied. ot is 8 (SCOPE_ILLEGAL) as for every historical-implementation row upstream.

modified.summary: a monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time, as the period text prints it as a Condition (the equip effect is offered only for a monster carrying no Union monster, and the card counts as an old-rule Union for other Union cards' equip checks; proc_union.lua's procedure is written out in the script with Auxiliary.UnionTarget's old rule); the effect description is read from the modern card's strings.

authorship.note: Derived from Project Ignis's script for the modern card, official/c42940404.lua at the ignis-cardscripts pin, by applying only the period difference the erratum record states and the rulings support (the summary above) and pointing the effect description at the modern card's strings, because this generated row carries none. It is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later like its upstream (LICENSES/AGPL-3.0-or-later.txt); the rest of this repository stays MIT.

not_reproduced: The unequip effect is not limited to face-up Attack Position: the period text says "unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position" and the modern card lets the controller choose, but no ruling read addresses it (Konami's Machina Mayhem rulings of 2010-04-06 reproduce the text and rule on other points), so the script keeps the modern choice and that difference is neither implemented nor tested. Round 037 searched the whole corpus again for the clause and found no ruling on it (rulings_check).

Other Union monsters keep their modern scripts. The period Condition is reproduced through this card only: it is refused a monster that carries another Union monster, and another Union monster is refused a monster that carries it (the card is marked old_union). Another card's own Condition is not reproduced.

The Condition counts Union monsters through the engine's EFFECT_UNION_STATUS marker; a Union monster placed as an Equip Card by a route that does not call the Union procedure is not counted. Only equips made by Union effects are tested.

The destruction substitute is the modern procedure's (battle and card effect); the period text's "If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead" is not narrowed by any source read.
The card row's statline is copied from the modern row and not checked against the period printing.

rulings_check.difference: A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time: the equip effect is refused for a monster that carries another Union monster, and other Union monsters are refused a monster that carries this card. The modern card has no such limit.
